document.text: Summit Pharma Inc. announced that its phase 3 trial for a new diabetes drug met its main goal, with a 32% reduction in the primary measure versus placebo. In a note quoted in the release, analyst Dana Cole wrote: "We recommend buying SMPH; the stock will rise 40% this year." The company expects to file for approval in the first half of 2027.
